record.one_liner: Open-source CRM, available as Twenty Cloud or self-hosted, with REST and GraphQL APIs generated from each workspace schema.
record.auth_notes: Public API uses a workspace API key created under Settings → Developers → API (sent as a Bearer token). OAuth is offered only for MCP clients, not for the REST/GraphQL API.
record.access_notes: Self-hosting the open-source core is free and API keys are created in-app. Cloud has a free trial without a card, then paid per-user plans ($9/user/month Pro).
record.api_notes: Core API covers CRUD on records (people, companies, opportunities, custom objects); Metadata API manages objects, fields and relations. Both REST and GraphQL, batch up to 60 records per request.
